item.title: Re: Question:
item.content:encoded:
Basically, checking all the information in that entry is so far correct. Also, if you know there's another mention somewhere, it would be good to add it in.

My thinking with the re-verifying process is that we can just re-do it with different symbols as and when it becomes necessary. There're more than enough weird alt codes to meet out needs.

item.title: Question:
item.content:encoded:
What does 'fully verified' mean? Is that something you (MaliceAforethought) can only do, or is it something other people can do on your behalf?

Does it mainly consist of doing a search for the MTF name to see how many occurrences exist, and verifying that those occurrences are all represented on the page? If so, we could note this on the page itself (so you don't have to verify every single MTF yourself, as I imagine that would be super-tedious to do by yourself).

Not to make this too complex, but an alternate scheme might be to have a 'last verified' field that precludes the MTF designation; if blank, it hasn't been verified — if filled, it indicates when the designation was last verified (so we can re-verify every once and a while when the date is clearly from a while back).

Finished adding all the descriptions (again, most were scp specific or just undescribed). Also added documentation for Mu-0, Psi-9, and Psi-13. Added additional name logs for some MTFs with more than one nickname that the scan program hadn't picked up. Added the Psi-9 logo.

All told, the data here should be fully correct and complete now. In the future, efforts should be made to add task forces written in articles published after the last time Crayne scanned the database, since many task forces written in series 4 or late series 3 are not yet listed.

Neutralization of or defence against clown-related SCPs.
